parsed.refutation_attempt: Examined the sink at line 24 and verified that the call is to a custom thread creation function (threadCreate). The arguments passed are an integer priority (prio - 1), a NULL pointer, stack size, and other numeric flags – none of which construct or invoke an OS command string. Since OS Command Injection requires an untrusted string to be passed to an exec or system‑family call, this code path does not meet that criterion. No string concatenation or command execution occurs, and the prio value influences only the scheduling priority of the thread, not a command line. Therefore the reported vulnerability is not present.
